items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: I had Peter Booker, Anoram Twyye, I believe one time Charlie Love, I think. Harrison Barnes on trombone, Buddy Johnson on trombone, Joe Pye, George Hooker.

ctx.x: Oh, back to the Excelsior band, that's another thing we talked about before. Who were some of the trumpet players there?
I had Peter Booker, Anoram Twyye, I believe one time Charlie Love, I think. Harrison Barnes on trombone, Buddy Johnson on trombone, Joe Pye, George Hooker.
